nodes.name: Simulated Acid Copper Wastewater Preparation
nodes.procedure: The simulated acid copper process washing wastewater was configured using CuSO4·5H2O, H2SO4, and NaCl according to the measured solute concentration in the primary washing tank of the electroplating plant and the theoretical formula of the electroplating bath.
nodes.source_text: The simulated acid copper process washing wastewater was configured using CuSO4·5H2O, H2SO4, and NaCl...

nodes.name: Simulated Nickel Wastewater Preparation
nodes.procedure: The simulated nickel plating process washing wastewater was configured using NiSO4·6H2O and NiCl2·6H2O according to the measured solute concentration in the primary washing tank of the electroplating plant and the theoretical formula of the electroplating bath.
nodes.source_text: the simulated nickel plating process washing wastewater was configured using NiSO4·6H2O and NiCl2·6H2O...

nodes.name: Simulated Zincate Wastewater Preparation
nodes.procedure: The simulated zincate zinc plating process washing wastewater was configured using ZnO and NaOH according to the measured solute concentration in the primary washing tank of the electroplating plant and the theoretical formula of the electroplating bath.
nodes.source_text: the simulated zincate zinc plating process washing wastewater was configured using ZnO and NaOH.

nodes.name: Primary SWDIM Freezing + Centrifugal Separation
nodes.procedure: 100 L of simulated primary washing tank wastewater was subjected to SWDIM freezing treatment using supercooled water dynamic ice making equipment (15 kW refrigeration capacity) to form ice crystals (80% freezing ratio), followed by centrifugal dehydration at 820 rpm for 2 min using a centrifugal dehydrator (200 W) to separate ice crystals and concentrated wastewater.

unit_operations.name: SWDIM Freezing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: wastewater is lowered to below 0°C, supercooled water formed, flow impacts baffle to generate small ice crystals, plastic screen and filter cloth separate ice from circulation loop

unit_operations.name: Centrifugal Dehydration
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Ice crystals put into filter bag in centrifugal dehydrator for solid-liquid separation

nodes.source_text: SWDIM freezing test... centrifugal dehydration for 2 min

nodes.name: Secondary SWDIM Freezing + Centrifugal Separation
nodes.procedure: Primary concentrated wastewater underwent secondary SWDIM freezing treatment to form ice powder, followed by centrifugal dehydration for 2 min. The final concentrated wastewater (14 vol%) was then evaporated and concentrated 2.8 times for electroplating bath reuse.

unit_operations.name: Secondary SWDIM Freezing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: simulated nickel plating washing wastewater with Ni2+ concentration of 3757 mg/L first underwent SWDIM to form ice powder

unit_operations.name: Centrifugal Dehydration
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: then underwent centrifugal dehydration for 2 min
